title: Mobile Responsiveness Audit — Viewport, Admin Layout, Touch Optimization
content:
Mobile responsiveness audit identified 3 critical and 2 moderate issues across the codebase.

**Sub-tasks**:
- UI-010-A: Viewport meta tag + Touch/scroll CSS (low risk, independent)
- UI-010-B: Admin sidebar responsive drawer + enrolments table scroll (medium risk, depends on D)
- UI-010-C: Navbar logo + CourseCard mobile fixes (low risk, independent)
- UI-010-D: useBreakpoint shared hook (low risk, foundation for B)

Order: D → A + C (parallel) → B

findings: CRITICAL: No `export const viewport` in root layout — mobile browsers may render at incorrect zoom
CRITICAL: Admin sidebar is always visible (fixed w-56, no collapse) — unusable below ~768px
MODERATE: No JS breakpoint hooks — mobile menus stay visible on window resize
MODERATE: Missing touch/scroll CSS — no -webkit-overflow-scrolling, touch-action, overscroll-behavior
MINOR: Navbar logo clipPath polygon may protrude horizontally on small screens
MINOR: CourseCard uses static w-1/3/w-2/3 that persist in flex-col mobile layout
MINOR: Admin enrolments 10-column table requires excessive horizontal scrolling

comments: Full audit report and findings from 2026-09-13 automated exploration
acceptance: TBD — card is in backlog, scope needs refinement before implementation
